lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.31 - A Listen and read

details: Listen and read develops students’ ability to connect spoken language with written text, helping them build confidence in reading along with audio support.
Look for careful listening, accurate recognition of key vocabulary including new words, and appropriate intonation when reading aloud.
“You all have superpowers! Think about all the things you can do. Let’s ready about ome boy and his superhero family.”

Heads Up (Reading): 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and help Ss to understand the text by asking questions, practicing skimming (reading for gist), scanning (reading for specific information) and detail (reading for comprehension). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.31 - B. Choose the correct answers

details: Choose the correct answers develops reading comprehension by guiding students to focus on key details in short sentences.
Look for correct answer choices, neat bookwork and good comprehension.
“Are you a superhero quiz master with an amazing memory?  See if you can answer these questions!”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

Homework Check:
Have Ss open to the previous lesson’s homework. Score completion %. Conduct activity feedback and error correction. Score achievement %. 
Project Gallery:
Check and encourage Ss to complete the project prompts so that they are ready to present by lesson 7,

Homework Set:
Complete an example of the homework to check Ss understanding. Have Ss then write the homework page, activity and plan in their diaries. 
Leaderboard:
Show the Leaderboard and congratulate / encourage daily app practise.

lessonPlan.topic: Phonics Book p.113-115 - A Look and say

details: Look and say supports accurate sound production by introducing the target letter sound and helping students connect each picture with its sound.
Look for careful reading, clear pronunciation of the target letter sound and students identifying the correct picture–sound match.
“Time to use your English super powers! Can you find the right sound for each picture?”

lessonPlan.topic: Phonics Book p.113-115 - A Colour words with y in yellow. Colour words with x in red. Colour words with z in orange.

details: Colour words helps students practise specific letter recognition and reading accuracy by identifying words that contain the target letter in a group of words and colouring them as instructed.
Look for correct selection of words with the target letter, careful colouring and students checking each word.
“Time to colour, superheroes! Can you use your x-ray vision to spot the letters in these words?”
